Author: Anomaly
Name: Eorzea Timers
Punchline: Create and track personalized timers in FFXIV.
Description: Create persistent manual and game-linked countdown timers with configurable alerts, snooze controls, and an in-game overlay.
Changelog:
Stage 7 - Game-linked Housing Timer
- Added the first game-linked source for the Housing Lottery cycle.
- Added separate Manual Timers and Game-linked Timers sections.
- Housing targets automatically follow the five-day entry and four-day results schedule.
- Linked timers require no manual synchronization command or button.
- Added Convert to Manual and linked indicators in the manager and overlay.
- Added per-timer alert volume from 0% through 200% with live preview support.
- Existing timers migrate to 100% volume without losing settings.
- Save is disabled when clean; Cancel now becomes Revert Changes or Close when appropriate.
